reason: The finding misreads the field: Instrument.former_name is documented and implemented as 'the retired symbol, when answered as its renamed form' (populated only from the NSE symbol-change lane when the QUERY was a retired ticker), not a legal-name-change history, so null on a query for the current, never-changed symbol FUSION is correct by design. The claimed user consequence also does not hold: querying the old company name on the isolated stack returns FUSION (Fusion Finance Limited) as the top candidate (0.88 for 'Fusion Micro Finance Limited', 0.67 for 'Fusion Micro Finance'), so a user searching the pre-2024 name is steered to the right entity (via a disambiguation list rather than a confident resolve, a residual polish gap at most).
evidence: sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:239 (former_name = 'the retired symbol, when answered as its renamed form'), sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:192-203 (RenameAnnotation: NSE symbol-change lane), sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:782-824 (_rename_instrument sets renamed_from=inst.symbol only when nse_symbol_change.lookup_current hits), sidecar/services/symbol_resolver.py:896 (former_name derived solely from inst.rename)
evidence_checked: Opened the resolver dataclass, rename lane and enrichment join; re-ran resolve against the isolated stack :52152 at 2026-09-23T01:08Z for the old legal name.
repro_check: curl -s '127.0.0.1:52152/resolve?q=Fusion+Micro+Finance+Limited' -> needs_disambiguation=true, candidates[0]={FUSION, 'Fusion Finance Limited', NSE, 0.88}; q=Fusion+Micro+Finance -> candidates[0]=FUSION at 0.6667

reason: Real but over-graded: the app does not show a silent blank, it serves dividend_yield/dividend_per_share/dividend_per_share_ttm as null with field_meta status 'unavailable' + reason 'provider did not publish this field', which the Equity Overview renders as an 'unavailable' chip (and the brief simply omits the Div yield card) - per the diff spec an honestly labelled gap is not a medium. The residual gap is real (screener confirms Dividend Yield 0.00% and 0% payout every FY, so 'unavailable' understates a known zero for a never-payer), which is low-severity polish for income screening, not a wrong value shown as true.

reason: Holds: revenue_ttm is a straight pass-through of yfinance info.totalRevenue (no app-side rollup, so the fix is a cross-check, not a rollup audit) and 858.2cr does not reconcile to any standard NBFC definition - screener's trailing 4 quarters (Sep25-Jun26) sum to 1,699cr total revenue and 1,160cr net of interest (539cr), and the same provider's own FY26 annual Total Revenue is 1,513cr - while net income ties (168.5 vs 168cr). It is served status 'ok' and drives the brief's 'Revenue' card, company_narrative 'Revenue (TTM)', and the derived price_to_sales 3.49 (vs ~1.76 true) and profit_margin 19.6% (vs ~10%), so a P/S<2 screener preset would wrongly exclude this name.
